logp.method_description: Partition coefficients were measured by the shake-flask method. Briefly, equal volumes of n-octanol and PBS were mixed, and different concentrations of the compound were added and vigorously shaken for 12 h. Pt content was determined by ICP-MS. The n-octanol–water partition coefficient (LogPo/w) was calculated using the formula LogPo/w = LogCo/Cw, where Co and Cw represent the concentration of the complexes in n-octanol and water, respectively.
